stronger_left_out.name: Mount Lamington
stronger_left_out.reason: Two counted sources (national tourism site's Oro page and its Mount Lamington page): a dormant volcano and the 1951 eruption story, with memorial sites and small exhibits near Popondetta. But the page says climbing it is not common (safety and cultural reasons) and the memorials are in Popondetta, so the visit is a view plus memorials.
